about_the_game:
Q REMASTERED Original Soundtrack Vol. 2!

The second volume of the Q REMASTERED soundtrack, featuring 50 new tracks, is now available on Steam!

It includes the BGM of each stage's menu screen and game screen from VAULT-A3 to EVERYONE 14.

That BGM that plays when you stumble upon a problem... Do you all remember it?
